guidance.statement: Management intends to maintain an EBITDA margin corridor to provide operating flexibility despite recent high performance.
guidance.quote: we would still prefer to keep a corridor, which gives us enough operating flexibility. So no need to change it at this stage.

guidance.statement: The company expects core growth categories to grow at a multiple of real GDP.
guidance.quote: we always indexed our growth of our categories to a multiple of the real GDP growth.

guidance.statement: Management expects growth businesses to deliver significantly higher volume growth than core categories.
guidance.quote: For our growth businesses... we are in the range of 2x to 4x, but we are seeing accelerated momentum.

guidance.statement: The company aims to deliver consistent double-digit underlying volume growth.
guidance.quote: I think we have always maintained that we will deliver double digit. As a matter of fact, our endeavor will be to slowly but surely inch it up.

guidance.statement: Management anticipates margins could reach the upper end of their guidance if commodity prices remain stable.
guidance.quote: your assumption is correct that we would manage the business well within the band. And it is quite possible that we could be middle to higher end.

achieved.claim: Standalone revenues grew by 22.2% with underlying volume growth of 11.3%.
Consolidated profit after tax grew by 30.3% during the quarter.
Standalone EBITDA margins improved to 26.4%, up 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
Consumer and Bazaar domestic subsidiaries recorded revenue growth of 17%.

pushback.concern: Whether double-digit price hikes are excessive given recent falls in raw material costs.
Impact of new competition from cement and tile manufacturers in the adhesive segment.
Sustainability of high margins given the benefit of low-cost inventory this quarter.
Potential for channel upstocking to have artificially inflated Q1 volume growth numbers.

output.tone_why: Management highlights strong volume growth, market share gains, and successful proactive pricing despite geopolitical headwinds.
